thread.title: Jobs roundup: 8 firms to hire 150-plus Orlando workers

author: Matthew Richardson
title: Jobs roundup: 8 firms to hire 150-plus Orlando workers
text: – Staff writer, Orlando Business Journal Mar 2, 2018, 2:46pm EST Plenty of firms in the Central Florida area are looking for talented individuals to hire. Here, OBJ provides a roundup of companies that include video game services, software develop, financial help and more with high-tech, high-wage job openings. Electronic Arts : EA Tiburon, a subsidiary of video game giant Electronic Arts (Nasdaq: EA), has 56 positions open for Orlando. The company is looking for game designers, engineers in almost every department, mobile designers and more. Superion LLC: The Lake Mary-based software company has 41 positions posted on its website , calling for project coordinators, project managers, software engineers and more. The company is on track to create 355 jobs in Lake Mary within two years. Those interested in applying might want to follow these tips from the CEO. Finastra: The financial services firm that was founded in 2017 has 14 job openings in Lake Mary. It is looking for a vice president of technology operations, director of software architecture, director of operations, director of software engineering and more. Aerojet Rocketdyne Inc: The Sacramento, Calif.-based aerospace company has 12 jobs open in Orlando , calling for a mechanical engineer specialist, test technician, safety and software engineers, and more. Katmai Government Services: The space and defense firm has 11 openings posted on its website , calling for system designers, test engineers and software developers. Digital Risk: The Maitland-based financial services firm is hiring 10 workers in Maitland. Job titles include senior software developer, stack web developer, java developer, processing manager and more. Blue Origin: The Kent, Wash.-based rocket firm is hiring workers for its $205 million, 750,000-square-foot rocket manufacturing plant in Merritt Island. The company has seven positions listed , calling for quality engineers, inventory manager, buyer, safety engineer, orbital launch site developer and safety technician. Apple Inc. (Nasdaq: AAPL): The Cupertino, Calif.-based iPhone maker has six positions listed on its website for its design center in Orlando. Job titles are graphics engineer, graphic verification engineer, formal verification engineer, graphics core hardware engineer and more. Ranked by C. Fla. employees Rank
